storage_redirect: User authorized /tmp because /data has I/O errors; no automatic migration or push

protocols.H: Read-only historical background, not a probe performance comparator
protocols.R: Exact historical train/val/test membership, independently train-fitted RFE and preprocessing
protocols.S: 20 leave-one-site-out splits; no validation or site input; all other sites train

image.missing: train feature median, all-missing train feature fixed zero

age.impute: train median, fallback zero if no observed train age
age.standardize: train mean and population SD, constant SD=1

sex.encoder: train-only OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown=ignore) plus explicit unknown indicator

phenotype_scale: train RMS norm of full age, age-missing, sex OHE and sex-unknown block; same slots and divisor for all ablations/nulls

svm.random_state: sha256 CMCV task calibration seed, identical across groups and nulls

null.algorithm: private SHA256-seeded random ordering plus nonzero cyclic shift within partition x site; joint raw age/sex, singleton unchanged

groups.N1: Top64 image x true phenotype neighbor vote
groups.N2a: 8 nulls: shuffled train-anchor phenotype, true queries
groups.N2b: 8 nulls: shuffled queries and anchors in their own partition x site

single_class_site: AUC and BA NA; absent-class recall and F1-ASD NA; CE/Brier retained
R_aggregation: per seed mean of 10 fold metrics, then mean and sample SD across 3 seeds; nulls are mean of 8 separate-fit metrics, not a probability ensemble
S_aggregation: pooled 871 OOF and valid site macro; weighted CE; retain all 20 sites

bootstrap.cluster: 20 sites; same site resamples across repeated R seeds, average seed statistics rather than concatenate subjects
bootstrap.interval: exploratory percentile 95%, no multiplicity-adjusted significance claims

resources.preferred: CPU sklearn; PPU matrix route only if end-to-end faster AND reference-equivalent
